ValidationRule.description: Desde el estado Proposal, el campo % Expected Probability y Booking Geography tienen que estar rellenos
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( opportunity_expiration_ind_type__c = false, NOT( $Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_DES_DataMigration__c ), OR(RecordType.DeveloperName='Business_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName='Draft_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName='Confidential_Opportunity'),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Approval'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Ready to close'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Closed Won'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Closed Lost')), OR( ISBLANK(DES_Expected_Probability__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(DES_Booking_Geography__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please check the Key Fields that are not completed: % Expected Probability or Booking Geography empty. It is necessary to fill them in order to advance the stage.
